Implementation: precompute `seq = [x % banks for x in range(ranges + lanes)]` once (in run_stream / run_burst). Then a fresh pointer matrix is `[seq[r:r+lanes] for r in range(ranges)]`.

Check: row r, lane l → seq[r+l] = (r+l) % banks ✓. And r+lanes-1 ≤ ranges-1+lanes-1 = ranges+lanes-2 < ranges+lanes ✓ so the slice is always in bounds ✓.

    seq = [x % banks for x in range(ranges + lanes)]
    def fresh():

    return fresh
